title: Typed CUDA d1 batch and isolated limit
question: Does the pinned d1 adapter preserve mixed native answer kinds and request association?
method: Use the BF16 CUDA worker and configured Nemotron handoff, grouping compatible independent requests with one deliberately oversize question population.
conclusion: Three requests retained text, number, date, multilabel Choice and noul outputs under their own identities. A fourth request returned question_count limited. This is native execution evidence only.
